Hero.title: Full Stack MERN Developer & Programming Instructor
Hero.description: I build modern web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js and MongoDB, and I also teach full-stack development and computer science fundamentals.

About.title: About Me
About.description: I'm a Full Stack Developer specialized in the MERN stack with a strong passion for building modern, scalable web applications. I also work as a programming instructor where I teach full-stack development and computer science topics to aspiring developers.
About.description2: Alongside development, I have experience in digital marketing and SEO-driven web development, helping businesses build production-ready websites that improve online visibility and user engagement.

items.description: Developed complete production-ready websites from design to deployment while managing digital marketing strategies including SEO, content planning and performance optimization.
Teaching a 90-hour MEAN Stack program covering Angular, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB while mentoring students in real-world full-stack projects.
Developed responsive web interfaces using Next.js and Tailwind CSS and trained students in frontend best practices.

Contact.title: Let's Work Together
Contact.description: If you are looking for a developer to build modern web applications or a programming instructor to mentor your team or students, feel free to reach out.
